input.question: How many vacation days do I get in my first year?
input.evidence: Time off policy: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 vacation days per month from their start date, up to 18 days per calendar year. Accrued days can be used after the 90-day probation period.

expected.answer: You accrue 1.5 days per month, up to 18 days a calendar year, and can use accrued days after the 90-day probation period.

input.question: Can I carry unused vacation into next year?
input.evidence: Time off policy: Up to 5 unused vacation days carry over into the next calendar year. Carried days expire on 31 March.

expected.answer: Yes, up to 5 unused days carry over, and they expire on 31 March.

input.question: Do I get paid for unused vacation if I resign?
input.evidence: Time off policy: Accrued, unused vacation is paid out on the final payslip in the countries where local law requires it. Elsewhere it is not paid out.

expected.answer: It depends on the country. It is paid out on the final payslip where local law requires it and not paid out elsewhere.

input.question: How long is parental leave?
input.evidence: Parental leave: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of paid leave and secondary caregivers 6 weeks. Leave must start within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

expected.answer: Primary caregivers get 16 weeks of paid leave and secondary caregivers 6 weeks, starting within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

input.question: Can I take sick leave to look after my dog?
input.evidence: Time off policy: Sick leave covers your own illness and the illness of an immediate family member. Pets are not covered.

expected.answer: No. Sick leave covers you and immediate family members, and pets are not covered.

input.question: What is the daily meal limit when I travel?
input.evidence: Travel policy: Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 60 USD per day with itemised receipts. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

expected.answer: Up to 60 USD per day with itemised receipts, and alcohol is not reimbursed.

input.question: Can I book a business class flight for a 7 hour trip?
input.evidence: Travel policy: Economy class is required for flights under 9 hours. Business class needs VP approval for flights of 9 hours or more.

expected.answer: No. Economy is required for flights under 9 hours; business class needs VP approval for flights of 9 hours or more.

input.question: How soon do I need to file expenses?
input.evidence: Expense policy: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the purchase. Late reports need manager approval and may be declined.

expected.answer: Within 30 days of the purchase. Late reports need manager approval and may be declined.

input.question: Can I expense my home internet?
input.evidence: Remote work policy: Employees working remotely at least three days a week receive a 40 USD monthly internet stipend, paid with payroll. It is not claimed through expenses.

expected.answer: Not through expenses. If you work remotely at least three days a week you get a 40 USD monthly internet stipend paid with payroll.

input.question: Does the company pay for my gym membership?
input.evidence: Wellbeing policy: The company offers a 25 USD monthly wellbeing allowance that can be used for fitness, meditation apps or counselling.

expected.answer: There is a 25 USD monthly wellbeing allowance that can be used for fitness, which would cover part of a gym membership, but the company does not pay for the whole membership.

input.question: How do I reset my laptop password if I am locked out?
input.evidence: IT help: Use the self-service portal at it.example.com/reset with your phone. If MFA is unavailable, call the service desk on extension 4000; they will verify you with your manager.

expected.answer: Use the self-service portal at it.example.com/reset with your phone. If MFA is unavailable, call the service desk on extension 4000, who will verify you with your manager.

input.question: Can I install my own software on my work laptop?
input.evidence: IT policy: Employees can install software from the approved catalogue in the Company Portal. Other software needs a security review ticket.

expected.answer: You can install anything from the approved catalogue in the Company Portal. Other software needs a security review ticket first.

input.question: Can I forward work email to my personal address?
input.evidence: Security policy: Automatic forwarding of company email to personal accounts is prohibited. Share files through the approved document system.

expected.answer: No. Automatic forwarding of company email to personal accounts is prohibited; share files through the approved document system.

input.question: I lost my phone with the authenticator app. What now?
input.evidence: IT help: Report a lost device to the service desk immediately. They will revoke sessions and re-enrol MFA after verifying your identity.

expected.answer: Report it to the service desk immediately. They will revoke your sessions and re-enrol MFA after verifying your identity.

input.question: Is it OK to use ChatGPT with customer data?
input.evidence: AI use policy: Customer data must not be entered into external AI tools. Use only the approved internal assistant for work involving customer data.

expected.answer: No. Customer data must not be entered into external AI tools; use only the approved internal assistant.

input.question: Do I get a second monitor?
input.evidence: IT help: Standard equipment is a laptop, one monitor, keyboard and mouse. Additional monitors need manager approval and a ticket.

expected.answer: Standard equipment includes one monitor; an additional one needs manager approval and a ticket.

input.question: When does my health insurance start?
input.evidence: Benefits: Health insurance begins on the first day of the month after your start date. Dependents can be added within 30 days of your start date.

expected.answer: On the first day of the month after your start date. Dependents can be added within 30 days of the start date.

input.question: Does insurance cover my partner?
input.evidence: Benefits: The plan covers spouses and registered domestic partners. Unmarried partners without registration are not covered.

expected.answer: Yes for a spouse or registered domestic partner; an unmarried partner without registration is not covered.

input.question: What is the 401k match?
input.evidence: Benefits: The company matches 100 percent of contributions up to 4 percent of salary. Matching vests after 2 years.

expected.answer: The company matches 100 percent of contributions up to 4 percent of salary, vesting after 2 years.

input.question: Can I get tuition reimbursement for a master's degree?
input.evidence: Learning policy: Up to 3000 USD per year is reimbursed for courses related to your role, with manager approval before enrolment. Degree programmes are not covered.

expected.answer: No. Reimbursement of up to 3000 USD a year covers role-related courses with prior manager approval, and degree programmes are not covered.

input.question: Can I accept a gift from a supplier?
input.evidence: Code of conduct: Gifts over 50 USD must be declined or reported to Compliance. Cash gifts are never allowed.

expected.answer: Only gifts of 50 USD or less; anything over must be declined or reported to Compliance, and cash is never allowed.

input.question: I think a colleague is falsifying expenses. What should I do?
input.evidence: Speak Up policy: Report concerns to Compliance or through the anonymous Speak Up line. Retaliation against reporters is prohibited.

expected.answer: Report it to Compliance or through the anonymous Speak Up line. Retaliation against people who report is prohibited.

input.question: Can I work for another company on weekends?
input.evidence: Code of conduct: Outside work is allowed if it does not conflict with company interests and is disclosed to your manager and HR in advance.

expected.answer: It is allowed if it does not conflict with company interests and you disclose it to your manager and HR in advance.

input.question: When is payday?
input.evidence: Payroll: Salaries are paid on the 25th of each month, or the previous business day if the 25th is a weekend or holiday.

expected.answer: On the 25th of each month, or the previous business day if the 25th falls on a weekend or holiday.

input.question: Why was my bonus taxed so heavily?
input.evidence: Payroll: Bonuses are paid with payroll and taxed under supplemental wage rules. The Payroll team cannot give personal tax advice.

expected.answer: Bonuses are taxed under supplemental wage rules. Payroll cannot give personal tax advice, so please ask a tax adviser.

input.question: Can I get an advance on my salary?
input.evidence: Payroll: Salary advances are not offered. Employees in hardship can contact HR about the Employee Assistance Fund.

expected.answer: No, salary advances are not offered. If you are in hardship, contact HR about the Employee Assistance Fund.

input.question: Can I work from another country for a month?
input.evidence: Remote work policy: Working abroad is allowed for up to 20 working days a year in countries where the company has an entity, with manager and HR approval. Other countries are not allowed for tax reasons.

expected.answer: Only for up to 20 working days a year, in a country where the company has an entity, with manager and HR approval.

input.question: How many days must I be in the office?
input.evidence: Remote work policy: Teams set an office schedule between 2 and 3 days per week, agreed with the manager.

expected.answer: Your team sets it, between 2 and 3 days a week, agreed with your manager.

input.question: What do I need on my first day?
input.evidence: Onboarding: Bring a government ID for the I-9 form. Your laptop is delivered to your home address the week before.

expected.answer: Bring a government ID for the I-9 form. Your laptop is delivered to your home address the week before you start.

input.question: Who is my buddy?
input.evidence: Onboarding: Every new hire is assigned a buddy by their manager before day one.

expected.answer: Your manager assigns a buddy before your first day. I do not have the name, so please ask your manager.
